AWS: lambda( to create the backend server) 

Cognito( for identity access and management) 

Api gateway( to create the api gateway)

Key findings 

**1\. How i was able to implement authentication:** 

**a. JWT** 

On the api getaway application i went to the authorization tab and attached authorizers to the route that i created (GET /class). 

![]()I selected the authorzer to be a JWT. then i filled in certain information in the settings and save it  
![]()Fig 3: Review of the implemented authorization in the get route 

![]()

**2\. Rate limiting**: this feature is used to prevent against DDOS attacks and DOS attacks. To implement this on my gateway i went to the API gateway application and under security i selected then i set a limit to the default route throttling.  
![]()  
3\. **HTTPS only**: This is the default configuration used on AWS. it ensures that all communications happen iver an encrypted channel thereby preventing MITM attacks. ![]()4\. **Access control / authorization using scopes:** this will grant a user access to only resources they are permitted to access 

To configure this i went to the cognito app and by default this are the scopes that are permitted.
